text: Two angles on a straight line are in the ratio 5:4. Find the smaller of the two angles.
explanation:
The two angles add up to 180°.

Total parts \(= 5 + 4 = 9\)

One part \(= \frac{180°}{9} = 20°\)

The angles are 100° and 80°.

The smaller angle is 80°.
